title.en: Example - Pressure in a Hydraulic Cylinder: Tractor 4100 Concrete Pump keeps Vertical is 15–45 m
title.zh: 示例 - 压力 在 液压 缸：拖拉机带动4100的订单包含印出的坍落度格保留「0.25 m³。」

description.en: Tractor 4100 Concrete Pump at /products/tractor-4100-concrete-pump. Vertical is 15–45 m Output is 6–12 m³/h
description.zh: 拖拉机带动4100的订单包含印出的坍落度格见 /products/tractor-4100-concrete-pump。0.25 m³。垂直是 15–45 m。

h1.en: Keep Tractor 4100 Concrete Pump under “Example - Force in a Hydraulic Jack” without new ratings
h1.zh: 在「示例 - 力 在 液压 Jack」下保留拖拉机带动4100的订单包含印出的坍落度格，不另写额定值

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for Tractor 4100 Concrete Pump. The row to open is /products/tractor-4100-concrete-pump. Vertical is 15–45 m. Output is 6–12 m³/h. Horizontal is 40–100 m. 4105 / 56 kW is Diesel 30. Not on the Electric 20 list used here. Writing 4105 on a tractor order mixes two paths. The rural diesel prints 800 kg, 17 kW and 5–8 m³/h. The order is this tractor-driven page, not a 4105 diesel trailer and not Diesel 40. Other pump sheets used here do not print this slump line, so do not copy 180–220 mm onto them. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Tractor-Driven 4100 as 40 kW, 6–12 m³/h, 15 MPa, 40–100 m / 15–45 m, aggregate 1–3 cm, hopper 0.25 m³, slump 180–220 mm, 2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm and 1300 kg. The section title “Example - Pressure in a Hydraulic Cylinder” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是拖拉机带动4100的订单包含印出的坍落度格的数字。要打开的行是 /products/tractor-4100-concrete-pump。0.25 m³。垂直是 15–45 m。水平是 40–100 m。此处使用的电动20列表上没有。输送量是 6–12 m³/h。4105 / 56 kW 是柴油30。在拖拉机订单上写 4105 会把两条路径混在一起。农村柴油泵印 800 kg、17 kW、5–8 m³/h。订单是这张拖拉机带动页，不是 4105 柴油拖泵，也不是柴油40。此处使用的其他泵页不印这行坍落度，所以不要把 180–220 mm 抄过去。河北品锦机械（邢台）把拖拉机带动4100印成 40 kW、6–12 m³/h、15 MPa、40–100 m / 15–45 m、骨料 1–3 cm、料斗 0.25 m³、坍落度 180–220 mm、2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm、1300 kg。节标题「示例 - 压力 在 液压 缸」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。

heading.en: Example - Pressure in a Hydraulic Cylinder
heading.zh: 示例 - 压力 在 液压 缸

body.en: Under “Example - Pressure in a Hydraulic Cylinder”, Tractor 4100 Concrete Pump contributes only the printed cells in this part. Vertical is 15–45 m. 4105 / 56 kW is Diesel 30. The rural diesel prints 800 kg, 17 kW and 5–8 m³/h. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Tractor-Driven 4100 as 40 kW, 6–12 m³/h, 15 MPa, 40–100 m / 15–45 m, aggregate 1–3 cm, hopper 0.25 m³, slump 180–220 mm, 2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm and 1300 kg.
body.zh: 在「示例 - 压力 在 液压 缸」下，拖拉机带动4100的订单包含印出的坍落度格这一节只放已印出的格子。河北品锦机械（邢台）把拖拉机带动4100印成 40 kW、6–12 m³/h、15 MPa、40–100 m / 15–45 m、骨料 1–3 cm、料斗 0.25 m³、坍落度 180–220 mm、2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm、1300 kg。4105 / 56 kW 是柴油30。农村柴油泵印 800 kg、17 kW、5–8 m³/h。垂直是 15–45 m。

heading.en: Example - Force in a Hydraulic Jack
heading.zh: 示例 - 力 在 液压 Jack

body.en: “Example - Force in a Hydraulic Jack” titles this part of the Tractor 4100 Concrete Pump note. The figures stay the printed ones. Output is 6–12 m³/h. Not on the Electric 20 list used here. The order is this tractor-driven page, not a 4105 diesel trailer and not Diesel 40.
body.zh: 「示例 - 力 在 液压 Jack」是拖拉机带动4100的订单包含印出的坍落度格这一节的标题。数字仍以已印的为准。输送量是 6–12 m³/h。此处使用的电动20列表上没有。订单是这张拖拉机带动页，不是 4105 柴油拖泵，也不是柴油40。0.25 m³。

heading.en: A Hydraulic Jack Lifting a Car
heading.zh: 液压 Jack 提升 Car

body.en: For Tractor 4100 Concrete Pump, the heading “A Hydraulic Jack Lifting a Car” does not replace a cell. Horizontal is 40–100 m. Writing 4105 on a tractor order mixes two paths. Other pump sheets used here do not print this slump line, so do not copy 180–220 mm onto them. The photograph is an image from the source page https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/pascal-laws-d_1274.html.
body.zh: 对拖拉机带动4100的订单包含印出的坍落度格而言，标题「液压 Jack 提升 Car」并不替换任何格子。水平是 40–100 m。在拖拉机订单上写 4105 会把两条路径混在一起。此处使用的其他泵页不印这行坍落度，所以不要把 180–220 mm 抄过去。配图来自来源页 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/pascal-laws-d_1274.html。

question.en: Does “Example - Pressure in a Hydraulic Cylinder” replace Vertical is 15–45 m?
question.zh: 「示例 - 压力 在 液压 缸」会替换「0.25 m³。」吗？

answer.en: No. Vertical is 15–45 m remains the printed wording for Tractor 4100 Concrete Pump.
answer.zh: 不会。0.25 m³。仍是拖拉机带动4100的订单包含印出的坍落度格已印的说法。

question.en: Where does Output is 6–12 m³/h belong on the Tractor 4100 Concrete Pump row?
question.zh: 拖拉机带动4100的订单包含印出的坍落度格这一行里，「垂直是 15–45 m。」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/tractor-4100-concrete-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/tractor-4100-concrete-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “Example - Force in a Hydraulic Jack” add to Tractor 4100 Concrete Pump?
question.zh: 「示例 - 力 在 液压 Jack」给拖拉机带动4100的订单包含印出的坍落度格增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/pascal-laws-d_1274.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/pascal-laws-d_1274.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。
